DTA selector role remains a candidate association from authoritative source index and table agreement; no native animation/state completion proof is added.
Named SprintSettingsIndex and SSA settings do not prove which sprint exit phase permits firing in native play.

siteImpact: No current source selection mismatch: ADS63/63, sprint63/63, deploy63/63. Existing ADS ratio, sprint recovery and deploy displays already use the site model. A separate source Holster setting is possible; absolute movement speed and total weapon-swap time are not supported.
